title: SREV-030 service query

audit_contract.description: MSGID: MSGID_SERVICE_QUERY | request: {"struct": "SERVICE_QUERY_REQ", "header": "MSG_HEADER h", "min_length": "sizeof(SERVICE_QUERY_REQ)", "payload_offset": "FIELD_OFFSET(SERVICE_QUERY_REQ, name)", "segments": [{"name": "name", "length_field": "name_len", "unit": "wchar", "max_chars": 256, "nul_terminated": true}]} | reply: {"struct": "SERVICE_QUERY_RPL", "header": "MSG_HEADER h", "payload": "QUERY_SERVICE_CONFIG plus service status/config data"}
